PilotProgress.title: Pilot Progress
PilotProgress.description: Stores the game progress for a user.

currentLevelId.description: The ID of the level the user is currently playing.

maxReachedLevel.description: The highest level the user has reached.

code.description: The user's current code in the editor.

hintsUsed.description: The number of hints the user has used.

assessmentComplete.description: Whether the user has completed the pre-assessment.

unlockedAchievements.description: A list of achievement IDs the user has unlocked.

lastUpdated.description: The timestamp of the last update.

/pilots/{userId}.description: Stores the game progress for each user, keyed by their Firebase Auth UID.
